summary:
羅克威爾自動化 EPS 超預期 14.55%、營收年增 11.9%，盤後微漲 0.14%，47.6 倍本益比偏高，工業自動化需求回暖但估值需進一步驗證。
• EPS $3.30 超越預估 $2.88，驚喜幅度 +14.55%，訂單積壓消化與新訂單回升共同推動業績超越。
• 單季營收 $22.39 億美元，年增 11.9%，工廠自動化與數位製造需求溫和復甦。
• 本益比 47.6 倍，市值 $511 億美元，對工業自動化大廠估值偏高，需持續業績超越才能維持。
• 盤後股價微漲 0.14%，市場反應平靜，顯示 EPS 超預期已反映在預期中或市場對前景仍持觀望態度。
• 11.9% 年增率顯示工業自動化市場在 2025 年去庫存後正逐步回暖，但回升速度尚稱溫和。
ai_view:
羅克威爾自動化本季呈現工業自動化回暖的早期訊號——14.55% EPS 驚喜反映執行效率優化，11.9% 年增率顯示市場正逐步走出 2025 年的去庫存低谷。然而 47.6 倍本益比在工業股中偏高，要求持續的業績超越才能維持。盤後溫吞的 0.14% 漲幅說明市場謹慎評估回暖持續性。對羅克威爾而言，最重要的中期驅動力是製造業「智慧化升級」的資本支出週期——AI 驅動的工業物聯網（IIoT）與數位工廠投資若持續加速，羅克威爾作為可程式化控制器（PLC）與工業軟體龍頭具備直接受惠資格。短期而言，財報提供溫和正面動能；中期而言，需追蹤製造業採購經理人指數（PMI）回升訊號及客戶資本支出計畫。追蹤指標：訂單積壓量（backlog）年增、智慧製造軟體（FactoryTalk）收入佔比成長、下季 EPS 指引走勢、以及美國製造業回流政策對客戶投資的帶動效果。整體屬於景氣回升型工業標的，需持續驗證回暖強度。

需留意：47.6 倍本益比在工業自動化股中屬高溢價，若製造業資本支出計畫因宏觀放緩而延後，訂單能見度將迅速惡化。；工業自動化市場過去一年受去庫存壓制，若回補週期短於預期，11.9% 年增率難以持續。；中國製造業競爭者（匯川技術、台達電子等）在中低端自動化市場的競爭力提升，可能侵蝕羅克威爾的新興市場份額。

summary_en:
Rockwell Automation beat EPS by 14.55% with 11.9% YoY revenue growth; a +0.14% post-earnings gain and 47.6x P/E reflect recovering industrial automation demand but elevated valuation.
• EPS of $3.30 beat the $2.88 estimate by 14.55%, reflecting order backlog digestion and recovering new order intake.
• Revenue of $2.24B grew 11.9% YoY, indicating moderate recovery in factory automation and digital manufacturing demand.
• P/E of 47.6x on a $51.1B market cap is elevated for an industrial automation company; sustained outperformance is required.
• Post-earnings stock edged up +0.14%, a muted response suggesting the market either expected the beat or remains cautious about the outlook.
• 11.9% YoY growth signals a gradual recovery in industrial automation after the 2025 inventory correction, but the pace is still moderate.

ai_view_en:
Rockwell Automation's quarter provides early signals of an industrial automation recovery—14.55% EPS beat reflects execution efficiency, while 11.9% growth indicates a gradual exit from the 2025 inventory correction trough. However, the 47.6x P/E is elevated for industrial stocks and requires consistent outperformance. The muted +0.14% post-earnings reaction reflects market caution about recovery durability. The key medium-term driver for Rockwell is the manufacturing 'smart upgrade' capex cycle—AI-driven IIoT and digital factory investment. If this cycle accelerates, Rockwell as the PLC and industrial software leader is well-positioned to benefit. Near-term, the earnings print provides modest positive momentum. Medium-term, monitor manufacturing PMI signals and customer capex plans. Key metrics: order backlog YoY growth, FactoryTalk (smart manufacturing software) revenue share expansion, next-quarter EPS guidance direction, and US reshoring policy impact on customer investment. A cyclical recovery play requiring ongoing validation of recovery strength.

Watch：At 47.6x P/E, any slowdown in manufacturing capex due to macro headwinds would quickly deteriorate order visibility.; Industrial automation market has been suppressed by inventory corrections; if the restocking cycle is shorter than expected, sustaining 11.9% growth would be challenging.; Chinese automation competitors (Inovance, Delta Electronics) are gaining competitiveness in mid-low-end automation, potentially eroding Rockwell's emerging market share.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 EPS 實際 $3.30 超越預估 $2.88，驚喜幅度 +14.55%，工業自動化訂單回升帶動業績。
